blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Monocular models recover 3D geometry from a single image in one pass, but most assume a pinhole camera and produce distorted geometry on the wide-angle imagery produced by fisheye and panoramic lenses. Camera-aware models remove this assumption by predicting a per-pixel ray field. However, they represent different camera geometries using a single fixed basis to capture both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that camera geometry can be viewed as having a hierarchy of complexity for representing rays. We present OmniRay, a feed-forward model whose Ray Module is composed of three components: a monotone radial base that captures radially symmetric structure, a spherical-harmonic residual for smooth deviations from it, and a free-form residual for remaining local variation. These components are composed as successive rotations on the sphere, allowing the representation to accommodate diverse camera geometries. Given a single image, OmniRay predicts a ray direction and an up-to-scale radial distance for every pixel, from which a 3D point cloud is recovered without needing camera information at inference time. Extensive experiments across different camera configurations demonstrate that OmniRay establishes a new state-of-the-art in camera-agnostic monocular 3D reconstruction.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Monocular 3D reconstruction recovers a 3D point for each pixel in an image.
We consider central cameras, in which all viewing rays pass through a single optical center, so each 3D point splits into a ray direction and a distance along that ray. The ray direction depends only on the camera geometry, while the distance depends on the scene under observation. Recent feed-forward models perform well on monocular 3D estimation ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , but their architectures or training data focus on pinhole cameras. When applied to wide-angle images, these assumptions often lead to distorted reconstructed geometry. Wide-angle cameras are common in robotics ( Yogamani et al., 2019 ) , augmented and virtual reality ( Engel et al., 2023 ) , and 360 ∘ 360^{\circ} capture ( Liao et al., 2022 ) , making this a practical limitation.
One way to handle these images is to calibrate the camera and rectify them to a pinhole view before reconstruction, but a pinhole cannot represent rays at or beyond 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} from its optical axis. As such, undistortion typically leads to cropping away part of the field of view or strongly stretching the image near its periphery, leading to low-confidence predictions from conventional depth estimation or 3D foundation models ( Guo et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
单相3D重建恢复了图像中每个像素的3D分.
我们认为中央相机,其中所有的收视光线都穿过一个光学中心,所以每个3D点会分裂成射线方向和沿着射线的相距. 射线方向仅取自相机几何,而距离取自所观测的场景. 近期的饲料前置模型在单体3D估计上表现良好(Yang等,2024;Wang等,2025b),但其架构或训练数据以针孔相机为主. 在被应用于广角图像时,这些假设往往导致被扭曲的重建几何. 广角相机常见于机器人(Yogamani等,2019年),增生与虚拟现实(Engel等,2023年),360QQ360QCirc}抓取(廖等,2022年)等,使得这成为了实际的限制.
处理这些图像的一种方法是在重建前校正相机并修正到针孔视图上,但针孔不能从它的光学轴上表示出90-∘90-^{\Circ}左右的射线. 因此,不完全化通常会导致部分视野被收割,或使图像被强烈地拉到其外围,从而导致传统深度估计或3D基础模型(Guo等人,2026年)的低信心预测。

blocks.en:
Camera-aware models instead account for camera geometry directly ( Bogdan et al., 2018 ; Tirado-Garín & Civera, 2025 ; Piccinelli et al., 2025 ) . DeepFocal ( Workman et al., 2015 ) and DeepCalib ( Bogdan et al., 2018 ) first use convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to estimate focal length and distortion of fixed camera models. Follow-up works generalize camera parameter estimation to arbitrary camera models by estimating ray fields directly.
In particular, UniK3D ( Piccinelli et al., 2025 ) predicts a per-pixel ray field using a spherical-harmonic (SH) basis and a radial distance along each ray. It can therefore reconstruct pinhole, fisheye, and panoramic images without camera metadata. In this formulation, the same basis must describe both the overall camera projection and its finer variations. We argue that there exists a hierarchy of complexity in camera geometry estimation, which can lead to more efficient and performant design. Many camera projections have a simple structure: for approximately radially symmetric lenses, a smooth radial function is sufficient to describe how viewing directions change across the image. Spherical harmonics can be used to complement radial functions.

blocks.en:
We therefore propose OmniRay – that takes a single image and predicts a dense, up-to-scale 3D reconstruction without intrinsics or camera-type input (Fig. 1 ). A shared image encoder feeds two modules. The Ray Module predicts a monotone radial base and the two residuals, each of which refines the preceding ray field. The Distance Module predicts the radial distance of each pixel, and the corresponding 3D point is obtained by scaling its predicted ray. We train OmniRay on cameras ranging from pinhole to panorama and evaluate it on held-out scenes, datasets, and camera configurations.
An oracle analysis examines which ray fields each representation can express, while benchmark experiments and ablations test the performance of the proposed components.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们提议OmniRay — — 仅取一幅图像,并预测一个密集的、可更新的3D重建,而不包含内在内容或相机类型的输入(图1)。 一个共享的图像编码器为两个模块提供了信息. 雷克模组预测出一个单通光圈基和两个残基,每个残基都精炼出之前的射线场. 距离模块预测出每个像素的射线距离,相应的3D点通过缩放其所预测的射线得到. 我们用从针孔到全景的相机来训练OmniRay, 用被搁置的场景、数据集和相机配置来评价它。
一项甲骨文分析检查了每个表述可以表达的射线字段,而基准实验和活化测试了拟议组成部分的性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Camera calibration determines the mapping from image pixels to rays in the camera frame. Classical methods parameterize this mapping with a low-dimensional model whose parameters are estimated from geometric observations ( Zhang, 2000 ; Scaramuzza et al., 2006 ) .
Different camera geometries are handled by different parametric models: pinhole model with radial and tangential distortion for conventional lenses, Kannala & Brandt (2006) model for wide-angle optics, and unified camera models ( Geyer & Daniilidis, 2000 ; Mei & Rives, 2007 ; Khomutenko et al., 2015 ; Usenko et al., 2018 ) for omnidirectional cameras.
Each of these models fixes a particular functional form, so a lens whose behavior departs from that form introduces residual error. Generic models relax these assumptions with more degrees of freedom and capture complex lens behavior ( Schops et al., 2020 ) at the cost of a higher-dimensional calibration problem.
blocks.zh:
相机校正决定了相机相框中从图像像素到射线的映射. 古典方法用一个低维模型参数化了这种绘图,其参数是通过几何观测估算的(Zhang,2000;Scaramuzza等,2006.).
不同的相机几何模型由不同的参数模型处理:有光圈和光线扭曲的针孔模型用于常规相机;有宽角相机模型Kannala & Brandt(2006);有统一相机模型(Geyer & Daniilidis,2000;Mei & Rives,2007;Khomutenko等,2015;Usenko等,2018)用于全向相机.
这些模型中每一个都固定了特定的功能形式,因此其行为偏离了该形式的镜头引入了剩余错误. 通用模型以更高的自由度来放松这些假设,并捕捉复杂的镜头行为(Shops等,2020年),以高维校正问题为代价.

blocks.en:
Learning-based methods offer an alternative to this high-dimensional calibration process by learning camera geometry directly from images without input calibration. DeepCalib ( Bogdan et al., 2018 ) regresses camera parameters, while Perspective Fields ( Jin et al., 2023 ) , GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) , and AnyCalib ( Tirado-Garín & Civera, 2025 ) move toward dense geometric cues: a per-pixel up-vector and latitude field ( Jin et al., 2023 ; Veicht et al., 2024 ) , or per-pixel rays ( Tirado-Garín & Civera, 2025 ) , each of which describes the camera more generally than a parameter vector.
Neural Ray Surfaces ( Vasiljevic et al., 2020 ) take it further by learning a free-form ray surface from video observations and directly representing the pixel-to-ray mapping.
These calibration approaches shift from explicit parameter estimation toward learning the pixel-to-ray mapping, but leave open how this mapping should be represented to remain both compact and expressive simultaneously .

神经Ray Surfaces(Vasiljevic等,2020年)通过从视频观测中学习出一个自由形态的射线表面,并直接代表了像素到射线的映射来取而代之.

blocks.en: Recent foundation models have improved depth estimation through large-scale training and distillation ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , but do not explicitly model the camera geometry. Depth Anything 3 ( Lin et al., 2025a ) instead predicts depth with per-pixel rays by modeling camera geometry alongside scene structure. Camera-aware models specifically account for camera geometry in monocular depth estimation. UniK3D ( Piccinelli et al., 2025 ) represents a per-pixel ray field with spherical-harmonics and predicts radial distance along each ray to handle diverse camera geometries without camera metadata. Depth Any Camera ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and UniDAC ( Ganesan et al., 2026 ) instead transform images into a common equirectangular representation to process different camera types before depth estimation, but require input camera intrinsics for the transformation. CAM3R ( Guruprasad et al., 2026 ) and Wid3R ( Jung et al., 2026 ) extend the spherical-harmonic ray representation to multi-view feed-forward 3D reconstruction. Together, these works highlight the value of explicitly accounting for the pixel-to-ray mapping for camera-agnostic 3D geometry, while leaving open whether a single ray representation is necessary for all camera geometries .

blocks.en: 4.2 Datasets and Camera Types
blocks.zh: 4.2 数据集和相机类型

blocks.en: We train on two panoramic datasets, 2D3DS ( Armeni et al., 2017 ) , of indoor offices and corridors, and 360Loc ( Huang et al., 2024 ) , of larger indoor and outdoor environments, rendering perspective, fisheye, and panoramic views from each panorama; the 2D3DS perspective images are the real captures provided with the dataset. We evaluate on held-out scenes of both, and on two unseen datasets, PanoCity ( Guo et al., 2026 ) , of outdoor street-level captures, and CO3Dv2 ( Reizenstein et al., 2021 ) , of object-centric images. Two camera configurations are withheld from training entirely, a GoPro fisheye and a Nayar catadioptric camera ( Nayar, 1997 ; Baker & Nayar, 1999 ) , both satisfying our central-camera assumption. Sec. A.2 gives the splits and the camera specifications.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个全景数据集,即室内办公室和走廊的2D3DS(Armeni等,2017年)和360Loc(Huang等,2024年),对室内和室外环境、渲染视角、鱼眼和每个全景进行训练;2D3DS视角图像是数据集提供的真实捕获。 我们评价了两地的被搁置场景,以及两个不可见的数据集,即以物体为中心的图像的PanoCity(Guo等,2026年)和CO3Dv2(Reizenstein等,2021年)。 两种相机配置完全不用于训练,一种是GoPro Fisheye和Nayar Catadioptric相机(Nayar,1997;Baker & Nayar,1999年),两者都满足了我们的中央相机假设。 第A.2条给出了拆分和相机规格.

blocks.en: During training we augment each panorama with randomly sampled synthetic central cameras, each defined by a viewing direction, a monotone radial profile drawn from positive spline increments, and an imaged sensor region. This single family covers filled and annular domains, from pinhole to wide-angle lenses. Draws whose profile falls close to a held-out geometry are rejected, so neither withheld camera nor its neighborhood appears in training. Sec. A.2 gives the sampling ranges and the rejection criteria, and Fig. 8 shows sampled examples.
blocks.zh: 在训练期间,我们用随机抽取的合成中央相机增强每个全景,每个相机都由一个取景方向、从正向丝状增量中抽取出的一个单通光圈图谱和一个成像传感器区域来定义。 这个单一的家族覆盖了从针孔到广角镜头的填充和废除域. 画画的外形接近被搁置的几何图案被否决,因此在训练中既不出现被扣留相机,也不出现其附近. Sec. A.2给出了采样范围和拒绝标准,图8显示了被采样的例子.

blocks.en: UniK3D ( Piccinelli et al., 2025 ) and Depth Anything 3 (DA3) ( Lin et al., 2025a ) jointly predict camera geometry and scene structure and are evaluated on all metrics; we fine-tune UniK3D on the 2D3DS and 360Loc panoramas so that it sees the same source imagery we train on. GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) and AnyCalib ( Tirado-Garín & Civera, 2025 ) calibrate the camera without predicting scene geometry. We convert their estimated cameras to dense ray fields for evaluation so all methods are scored identically.
blocks.zh: UniK3D(Piccinelli等,2025年)和深度Anything 3(DA3等)(Lin等,2025年a)联合预测相机几何和场景结构,并在所有度量标准上进行评估;我们在2D3DS和360Loc全景上微调UniK3D,使其看到我们训练的同源图像. GeoCalib (Veicht等, 2024年)和AnyCalib (Tirado-Garín & Civera, 2025年)在不预测场景几何的情况下校正相机. 我们把他们估计的相机转换成密集的射线场进行评估,以便所有的方法都得到相同的分数。

blocks.en: Fig. 4 compares ray fields and camera-frame point clouds on unseen PanoCity and CO3Dv2 images, with each ray field colored by its angular error. On the panorama, OmniRay keeps the road continuous while UniK3D breaks it across the image and DA3 fails to recover the ground structure. On the fisheye and GoPro rows, OmniRay keeps the road, pavement, and lane markings straight where UniK3D bends them and DA3 also distorts the surrounding buildings. On the held-out catadioptric camera both baselines produce degraded reconstructions. On the CO3Dv2 pinhole example, OmniRay remains comparable to the baselines, demonstrating that the additional flexibility for wide-angle cameras does not come at the expense of pinhole imagery. On in-the-wild images, OmniRay also recovers coherent 3D structure, as shown in Fig. 6 .
blocks.zh: 图4比较了未见的PanoCity和CO3Dv2图像上的射线场和相机-帧点云,每个射线场由它的角出错来取色. 在全景上,OmniRay保持了道路的连续性,而UniK3D则突破了图像,而DA3未能恢复地面结构. 在鱼眼和GoPro行道上,OmniRay保留了道路、人行道和道道标,其中UniK3D弯曲,DA3也扭曲了周围的建筑物。 在被搁置的catadioptric相机上,两个基线都会产生退化的重建. 在CO3Dv2针孔的例子上,OmniRay仍然与基线相当,表明宽角相机的额外灵活性不会以针孔图像为代价. 如图6所示,OmniRay还恢复了连续的3D结构。

The spherical base reduces panoramic error to 5.088 ∘ 5.088^{\circ} , while the free-form field performs best among single representations on panoramas, fisheye, and pinhole, but reaches 11.335 ∘ 11.335^{\circ} on the held-out catadioptric configuration. These results motivate combining a structured radial base with flexible residuals.

Adding the free-form residual further improves the panorama ( 0.399 ∘ 0.399^{\circ} ), fisheye ( 1.322 ∘ 1.322^{\circ} ), and catadioptric results ( 1.538 ∘ 1.538^{\circ} ) in the full staged model, which also outperforms both jointly trained three-term variants across all five configurations.

blocks.en: On pinhole cameras, the full model remains competitive at 0.418 ∘ 0.418^{\circ} . The additional spherical residual offers little benefit for this narrow-field geometry, while potentially providing greater flexibility across wide-field cameras. The VGGT-initialized variant ( Wang et al., 2025a ) illustrates a similar trade-off: it achieves the best pinhole error ( 0.330 ∘ 0.330^{\circ} ) but performs worse than the full model on the other four configurations. Since VGGT is pretrained for multi-view geometry on perspective imagery, its initialization may favor narrow-field projections over the broader range of camera geometries considered here. As the backbone is fine-tuned end-to-end in both settings, this comparison suggests an effect of initialization rather than a limitation in model capacity.
blocks.zh: 在针孔相机上,整个型号仍然具有0.418 ∘ 0.418 ^{\ Circ}的竞争力. 额外的球面残基对于这种狭地几何学没有什么好处,同时有可能在宽地相机上提供更大的灵活性. VGGT-初始化的变体(Wang等,2025a.)说明了类似的取舍:它实现了最佳的针孔出错(0.330 ∘ 0.330 ^{\ Circ}),但表现比其他四个配置的完整模型更差. 由于VGGT在视角成像上为多视图几何学预受了训练,它的初始化可能有利于对本文所考虑的更广泛的相机几何进行狭地预测. 由于骨干在两种设置中都经过了细微的端到端的调整,这种比较表明是初始化的效果,而不是模型容量的限制.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We began with two questions: how the pixel-to-ray mapping can remain both compact and expressive, and whether a single representation is necessary for every camera geometry. OmniRay explores both by composing the ray field. A monotone radial base captures the structure of conventional lenses, a spherical-harmonic residual models smooth deviations that a radial profile cannot express, and a free-form residual accounts for remaining local variation. Each component is applied as a rotation on S 2 S^{2} , allowing the representation to adapt to different camera geometries without camera-type input or model selection. A shared distance module scales the predicted rays into a point cloud in a single forward pass, and sampling lenses continuously during training helps the composition generalize to held-out camera configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们首先提出了两个问题:像素到射线的映射如何既能保持紧凑又能表现力,每个相机几何图案是否需要单一的表示. OmniRay通过编织射线场来探索两者. 单色光圈基能捕捉出常规透镜的结构,球-相声残基模型平滑偏移,而光圈剖面无法表达,而剩余局部变异的可自由形式残基账户. 每个组件被应用为在S 2 S^{2}上进行旋转,使得表示可以适应不同的相机相机相机相机,而无需相机型输入或模型选择. 一个共享的相距模块将预测的射线在单个前行通道中缩放成点云,在训练中连续地取出采样镜头,有助于将成份通俗化地用于所持相机配置.

The training images are captured near ground level, with horizons approximately aligned across images. As shown in Fig. 7 , on an in-the-wild aerial panorama with the horizon near the top of the frame, the predicted rays cover only a bounded, forward-facing region rather than the full viewing sphere. This example suggests that generalization depends not only on camera-projection diversity but also on the distribution of viewing altitudes represented during training.
